title: unified-rollouts: enhanced autorollback workflow with multi-metric quorum and staged shadow probing
author: Eva Chen
description:
Motivation: improve safety and signal quality for automated rollbacks in unified rollouts. Current autorollback relies on single-metric thresholds which can produce noisy decisions during transient regressions or metric sparsity in low-traffic canaries and shadow probes. This PR introduces a multi-metric quorum mechanism and staged shadow probing to reduce false positives and improve early detection of true regressions.

What this change does: 1) Adds a configurable quorum engine that evaluates a set of metrics (latency p99, error_rate, quality_score) and requires a majority or configurable fraction of metrics to cross thresholds before triggering rollback. 2) Implements staged shadow probing where probe traffic phases (probe->quarantine->release) use increasing sampling and stricter timeouts to avoid transient noise. 3) Integrates quorum decisions with the existing autorollback state machine and alerting hooks so that rollbacks are auditable and traceable. 4) Adds e2e canary simulation harness and unit tests for timing and quorum edge cases. 5) Adds observability docs and metric names for new signals.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-4210) - [x] Unit tests for quorum logic and probe timeout - [x] e2e canary simulation harness - [x] Metrics emitted for quorum decisions and verdicts - [x] Backwards compatible config defaults (default to previous single-metric mode unless multi-metric enabled)

Testing: Local unit and integration tests included. Ran canary simulation with historical traffic replay (see rollouts/e2e/canary_sim.py) to validate decrease in false rollback rate across 10 synthetic regressions. CI initially failed one flaky timing test; updated the test harness to use deterministic clocks.

Rollout plan: Feature gated behind rollout.flags.multi_metric_quorum (off by default). Start with 50% of canaries on proxy path in staging for 2 days, then expand to 10% production canaries for 72 hours, then opt-in for teams with high-sensitivity workloads.

Related: Linear ENG-4210, ENG-4211, linked Jira SUP-1203.

Add staged shadow probing state machine and sampling controls
Add e2e canary simulation harness and replay datasets
Emit telemetry for quorum decisions and rollback verdicts
Fix timing edge case in probe timeout handler and deterministic test clock
review_comments: Diego Martinez (requested_changes): The quorum approach looks good overall but we need to be explicit about metric weighting and how numeric scales are normalized. Can you add normalization utilities and a short note in the design doc about weight defaults?

Eva Chen (author): Added metric normalization utilities and documented default weights in docs/unified-rollouts/autorollback.md. The quorum engine uses min-max normalization per metric with an override table for known skewed metrics.

Priya Singh (comment): Please ensure all quorum decisions emit a decision_id and the contributing metric deltas to tracing so we can correlate alerts with metric signals. Also add an entry to rollback_metrics.md for these fields.
Eva Chen (author): Emitted decision_id and contributing_signals in telemetry; updated rollback_metrics.md and unit tests verify the payload shape.
Samir Patel (approved): Approving pending a small nits pass (doc wording and a small refactor suggestion in state_machine). Recommend squash merge once green.
CI (report): Initial test run failed test_autorollback::test_probe_timeout due to nondeterministic clock. Updated harness to use deterministic simulated clock; reran CI and all checks passed.
release_notes: Enhancement: Add multi-metric quorum and staged shadow probing to autorollback workflow. Feature gated off by default. Improves rollback precision and reduces false positives in low-traffic canaries.
